steps.title: Transcrições em private/ e SHA256SUMS

After aggregate.json it writes <runDir>/SHA256SUMS (aggregate.json plus all of private/, "<hex>  <path with />", sorted, LF); anything written under private/ or to aggregate.json must come before writeSums(dir). Its failure only warns. New internal helpers copyTranscripts and writeSums; test makeFake

steps.title: Custo por tentativa (costUsd e cost.total)

Every valid attempt now gets attempt.costUsd = attemptCostUsd(attempt) right after it is built (the lens-branch assignment is removed). aggregate.cost.total is the sum of costUsd over the valid attempts, or null without one. counters.cost keeps its meaning; a comment marks it as the roles-only cost that baseline.mjs and checkpoint.mjs read, while the caps use costUsd. Downstream steps can read aggregate.
